00010       ORG 30000
00020 ;********************
00030 ; SELECT FROM MENU
00040 ;********************
00050       ENT
00060       DI
00070       LD HL,POINT
00080       LD (PT),HL
00090       LD A,1
00100       LD (SEL),A
00110       CALL PLOT
00120 BACK  CALL KEYS
00130       CALL WAIT
00140       JR BACK
00150 ;---------------------
00160 KEYS  LD A,#FB
00170       IN A,(254)
00180       AND 1
00190       JR Z,UP    ;'Q'
00200       LD A,#FD
00210       IN A,(254)
00220       AND 1
00230       JR Z,DOWN  ;'A'
00240       LD A,#BF
00250       IN A,(254)
00260       AND 1
00270       JR Z,ENTER ;'ENT'
00280       CALL BORD
00290       JR KEYS
00300 ENTER LD B,A
00310       LD A,(SEL)
00320       LD C,A
00330       PUSH BC
00340       CALL CLS
00350       POP BC
00360       POP AF
00370       EI
00380       RET
00390 UP    LD A,(SEL)
00400       CP 1
00410       RET Z
00420       DEC A
00430       LD (SEL),A
00440       CALL PLOT
00450       LD HL,(PT)
00460       DEC HL
00470       DEC HL
00480       LD (PT),HL
00490       CALL PLOT
00500       RET
00510 DOWN  LD A,(SEL)
00520       CP 18      ;LIMIT
00530       RET Z
00540       INC A
00550       LD (SEL),A
00560       CALL PLOT
00570       LD HL,(PT)
00580       INC HL
00590       INC HL
00600       LD (PT),HL
00610       CALL PLOT
00620       RET
00630 ;-------------------
00640 PLOT  LD DE,DT1
00650       LD IX,(PT)
00660       LD L,(IX+0)
00670       LD H,(IX+1)
00680       PUSH HL
00690       CALL CHR
00700       POP HL
00710       CALL SQDN
00720       LD DE,DT2
00730       CALL CHR
00740       RET
00750 CHR   LD B,8
00760 CHR1  LD A,(HL)
00770       LD C,A
00780       LD A,(DE)
00790       XOR C
00800       LD (HL),A
00810       INC H
00820       INC DE
00830       DJNZ CHR1
00840       RET
00850 SQDN  LD DE,32
00860       RR H
00870       RR H
00880       RR H
00890       ADD HL,DE
00900       RL H
00910       RL H
00920       RL H
00930       RET
00940 ;-------------------
00950 WAIT  LD BC,13000
00960 SSS   DEC BC
00970       LD A,B
00980       OR C
00990       JR NZ,SSS
01000       LD BC,300
01010 SSS2  LD A,(BC)
01020       AND 16
01030       OR 0
01040       OUT (254),A
01050       DEC BC
01060       LD A,B
01070       OR C
01080       JR NZ,SSS2
01090       RET
01100 BORD  LD B,1
01110 B1    PUSH BC
01120       LD A,7
01130 B2    LD B,83
01140 B3    OUT (254),A
01150       DJNZ B3
01160       DEC A
01170       JR NZ,B2
01180       POP BC
01190       DJNZ B1
01200       RET
01210 ;-----------------
01220 ;
01230 ;*****************
01240 ; FANCY CLS
01250 ;*****************
01260 CLS   LD B,8
01270 CLS1  LD HL,16384
01280       LD DE,3072
01290 CLS2  SRL (HL)
01300       INC HL
01310       SLA (HL)
01320       INC HL
01330       DEC DE
01340       LD A,D
01350       OR E
01360       JR NZ,CLS2
01370       EI
01380       HALT
01390       HALT
01400       DI
01410       DJNZ CLS1
01420       RET
01430 ;*****************
01440 ; VARIABLES
01450 ;*****************
01460 SEL   DEFB 0
01470 ;---------------------
01480 DT1   DEFB 0,0,160
01490       DEFB 176
01500       DEFB 184,188,190
01510       DEFB 188
01520 DT2   DEFB 184,176,160
01530       DEFB 0,0,0,0,0
01540 ;---------------------
01550 PT    DEFW POINT
01560 POINT DEFW 16385,16449
01570       DEFW 16513,16577
01580       DEFW 18433,18497
01590       DEFW 18561,18625
01600       DEFW 20481,16400
01610       DEFW 16464,16528
01620       DEFW 16592,18448
01630       DEFW 18512,18576
01640       DEFW 18640,20619
01650 ;----------------------
01660 ; POINT IS A TABLE OF
01670 ; ADDRESSES FOR PLOTTING
01680 ; THE ARROW AT EACH
01690 ; SELECTION.
01700 ; DT1 AND DT2 ARE DATA
01710 ; THAT CONSTRUCT THE
01720 ; TOP AND BOTTOM CHR
01730 ; OF THE ARROW RESP/VELY.
01740 ; AS IT IS, THE ROUTINE
01750 ; RETURNS WITH BC EQUAL
01760 ; TO THE SELECTED NUMBER
01770 ; SO, CALL IT WITH
01780 ; 'LET X=USR START'
01790 ; AND EXAMINE X AFTERWARDS
